entities.name: ISO 20022
entities.description: Universal financial industry message scheme
entities.evidence: The ISO concepts of different parties are described in the table below.

entities.name: Debtor
entities.description: The party whose account is debited with the payment.
entities.evidence: The party whose account is debited with the payment.

entities.name: Ultimate Debtor
entities.description: The party who originally ordered goods or services and to whom the seller has sent the invoice.
entities.evidence: The party who originally ordered goods or services and to whom the seller has sent the invoice.

entities.name: Initiating Party
entities.description: The party on whose initiative the payment data is established.
entities.evidence: The party on whose initiative the payment data is established.

entities.name: Creditor
entities.description: The party whose account is credited with the payment.
entities.evidence: The party whose account is credited with the payment.

entities.name: Ultimate Creditor
entities.description: The party who is the ultimate creditor of the payment.
entities.evidence: The party who is the ultimate creditor of the payment.

entities.name: Debtor Agent
entities.description: The bank of the debtor.
entities.evidence: The bank of the debtor.

entities.name: Creditor Agent
entities.description: The bank of the creditor.
entities.evidence: The bank of the creditor.

entities.name: Case 1
entities.description: The account owner pays an invoice directly.
entities.evidence: The account owner pays an invoice directly.

entities.name: Case 2
entities.description: The invoice has been sent to the subsidiary, but the head-office initiates the payment on its behalf.
entities.evidence: The invoice has been sent to the subsidiary, but the head-office initiates the payment on its behalf.

entities.name: Case 3
entities.description: The head-office initiates the payment on behalf of its subsidiary.
entities.evidence: The head-office initiates the payment on behalf of its subsidiary.

entities.name: Case 4
entities.description: The shared service centre initiates the payment from the account of the head-office on behalf of the subsidiary.
entities.evidence: The shared service centre initiates the payment from the account of the head-office on behalf of the subsidiary.

entities.evidence: It contains identifying elements common to the entire message, such as NumberOfTransactions

entities.name: Party
entities.description: Entity involved in a payment transaction
entities.evidence: The ISO concepts of different parties are described in the table below.

entities.name: Invoice
entities.description: Document requesting payment for goods or services
entities.evidence: The party who originally ordered goods or services and to whom the seller has sent the invoice.

entities.name: Account Owner
entities.description: The owner of the account being debited or credited
entities.evidence: The account owner pays an invoice directly.

entities.name: Head-Office
entities.description: The main office of a company
entities.evidence: The head-office initiates the payment on behalf of its subsidiary.

entities.name: Subsidiary
entities.description: A company owned or controlled by another company
entities.evidence: The head-office initiates the payment on behalf of its subsidiary.

entities.name: Shared Service Centre
entities.description: A centralized unit providing services to multiple companies
entities.evidence: The shared service centre initiates the payment from the account of the head-office on behalf of the subsidiary.

entities.name: Financing Company
entities.description: A company providing financial services
entities.evidence: The payment is credited to the account of a financing company, but the ultimate creditor is a customer of the financing company.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: The party receiving goods or services
entities.evidence: The payment is credited to the account of a financing company, but the ultimate creditor is a customer of the financing company.

entities.name: Seller
entities.description: The party providing goods or services
entities.evidence: The party who is the ultimate creditor of the payment.

entities.name: Bank
entities.description: A financial institution providing banking services
entities.evidence: The bank of the debtor.

entities.name: Account
entities.description: A financial account held by a customer
entities.evidence: The account owner pays an invoice directly.

entities.name: Transaction
entities.description: A financial transaction
entities.evidence: The payment is credited to the account of a financing company, but the ultimate creditor is a customer of the financing company.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: The act of paying or being paid
entities.evidence: The payment is credited to the account of a financing company, but the ultimate creditor is a customer of the financing company.
